purpose: Retrieve the smallest governed market-data package capable of testing the three current DOSSIER-US W8E evidence gaps without treating proxy markets as the whole U.S. reality.
rules: Market instruments are observational proxies, not definitions of the U.S. economy or any Reality Grammar.
Broad-market and sector ETFs may support market-structure observations only; they do not establish economy-wide structural change alone.
Capital-flow observations must retain instrument, period type, start/end dates and provider timestamps.
Historical candlestick observations must retain adjustment mode, interval, field paths and pagination lineage when applicable.
Financial statements must retain issuer, statement type, reporting period, currency, accounting metadata and pagination lineage.
A provider payload is imported only after successful authorized retrieval; placeholder/template records never count as evidence.
No trade execution, recommendation, portfolio instruction or account action is part of this work.
